title: Michele Pickleball Anthem - Tres Idiomas
style: trilingual phonk anthem English Spanish Mandarin, Memphis phonk meets cinematic, heavy 808 bass, cowbell drops, female lead vocal with male chants, stadium energy, builds from atmospheric intro to aggressive drops, pickleball hype anthem, clean radio master
lyrics:
[Intro - Whisper + Vinyl Crackle]
Michele... pickleball... ¡Vamos!
加油! 加油!

[Drop 1 - SMASH CALL]
SMASH IT! SMASH IT!
Go for it, the time is right now!
Sooooo... SMASH IT!
¡Dale! 力量! Power up!

[Verse - Third Shot Wisdom]
Power in the fire, speed in the flame...
When every shot says none is right...
Michele still smashes!
¡Vamos Michele! 加油 Michele!

[Drop 2 - OVERDRIVE]
Point over, you're in overdrive!
¡SMASH IT! Fast steps shining bright!
冲! 冲! 冲! Go go go!

[Bridge - Sky Echo]
Her pickleball way up high in the sky...
It's talking to her... she hears the reply...
El cielo escucha... 天空在听...

[Hook - Wind in Favor]
Wind is in your favor, timeless...
Feel the breeze brush past your face...
No blinding rays in sight...
El viento... 风... contigo...

[Final Drop - FINAL VIBES]
Michele in overdrive... ¡Vamos!
Pickleball forever... 永远!
Can you feel its power?
SMASH IT! ¡SMASH! 加油!

[Outro - Crowd Fade]
Michele... pickleball... forever...
¡Vamos! 加油! SMASH!
